AlphaFoldVersionRadio.name: alphafoldversion
AlphaFoldVersionRadio.label: Version
AlphaFoldVersionRadio.help: AlphaFold 3: proteins, nucleic acids, ligands and ions; JSON input; needs your own model parameters. AlphaFold 2: proteins only; FASTA input; uses the shared model parameters.

pipelineNoteTwo.name: pipelineNoteTwo
pipelineNoteTwo.value: 2 jobs: CPU (MSA, templates) → GPU (prediction)

JSON.label: Input JSON
JSON.name: jsoninput
JSON.help: AlphaFold 3 input file (.json) with the sequences and settings. Leave empty to start from a skeleton you can edit in the preview.

MODEL.label: Model parameters directory
MODEL.name: modelinput
MODEL.help: Select the directory that contains af3.bin (or af3.bin.zst), the model parameters you received from Google DeepMind after registering for AlphaFold 3.

disclaimer.name: disclaimer
disclaimer.value: No af3.bin yet? Request the AlphaFold 3 weights with the AlphaFold 3 Google Form.

FASTA.label: Protein FASTA
FASTA.name: proteinfasta
FASTA.help: FASTA file with the protein sequence(s). Pick a file on the cluster, or one on your computer (it is uploaded).

RECYCLES.label: Recycles
RECYCLES.name: recycles
RECYCLES.help: Number of recycling iterations of the model. AlphaFold 3 default is 10; fewer is faster but less accurate.

SEEDS.label: Seeds
SEEDS.name: seeds
SEEDS.help: Number of random seeds (AlphaFold 3 --num_seeds). Each seed gives 5 diffusion samples and the best is ranked first; GPU time grows with the number of seeds. More seeds is the usual way to improve a low-confidence prediction. Leave empty to use the seed(s) in the input. Only possible when the input lists one seed.

ModelPresetDropdown.label: Model preset
ModelPresetDropdown.name: modelpreset
ModelPresetDropdown.help: monomer: single chain (no PAE). monomer_casp14: CASP14 setup, 8x ensembling, slower (no PAE). monomer_ptm: single chain with pTM and PAE. multimer: complexes of several chains (PAE, ipTM).

DBPresetDropdown.name: dbpreset
DBPresetDropdown.label: Databases
DBPresetDropdown.help: Full: complete genetic databases, most accurate, runs as a CPU job + GPU job. Reduced: smaller databases, faster, one GPU job, slightly less accurate.

DATEText.label: Max template date
DATEText.name: maxtemplate
DATEText.help: Only templates released on or before this date are used (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave empty for today.

presetPaeNote.name: presetPaeNote
presetPaeNote.value: The monomer and monomer_casp14 presets do not compute PAE (predicted aligned error); the results show an expected-distance map instead. Choose monomer_ptm for PAE at about the same cost.

pickleCheckbox.label: AlphaPickle plots
pickleCheckbox.name: pickle
pickleCheckbox.help: Make pLDDT plots (and PAE plots for monomer_ptm / multimer) with AlphaPickle after the run. Not available on Grace.

datadir.label: Database directory
datadir.name: datadir
datadir.help: OPTIONAL: AlphaFold 2 genetic databases and parameters. Default: /scratch/data/bio/alphafold/2.3.2

layout.title: RESOURCES
layout.summary: CPU stage $drona_walltime · GPU $gpu · GPU stage $walltimegpu · account $drona_account · email $email · extra $drona_extra_slurm

Walltime.label: Walltime: CPU stage
Walltime.help: OPTIONAL: time the CPU part (MSA and template search) will need; for reduced_dbs, the whole run. If the job exceeds it, it is killed and intermediate results may be lost, so be conservative. Default: 2 days.

cpu_stage_cores.label: Cores: CPU stage
cpu_stage_cores.name: cpu_stage_cores
cpu_stage_cores.help: Cores for the CPU job (MSA and template search). AlphaFold runs one search at a time with at most 8 threads (jackhmmer 8, HHblits 4), so more cores do not make it faster.

cpu_stage_mem.label: Memory (GB): CPU stage
cpu_stage_mem.name: cpu_stage_mem
cpu_stage_mem.help: Memory for the CPU job in GB. Very long sequences and large complexes produce large alignments and need more memory; small proteins need far less (a 20-residue test used 41 GB).

gpuDropdown.label: GPU type
gpuDropdown.help: GPU for the structure prediction job. Any GPU starts on whichever GPU is free first (the job adapts its settings to the GPU it gets); pick a type to wait for that GPU. The labels show free GPUs and jobs waiting now.
gpuDropdown.name: gpu

Walltimegpu.label: Walltime: GPU stage
Walltimegpu.help: OPTIONAL: time the GPU part (structure prediction) will need. If the job exceeds it, it is killed and intermediate results may be lost, so be conservative. Default: 1 day.
Walltimegpu.name: walltimegpu

email.label: Email notifications
email.help: Select if you want to be notified when your job changes status.
email.name: email

EMAILText.label: Email address
EMAILText.name: emailaddress
EMAILText.help: Provide email address to send status updates to. Default user is current user.

extraText.help: OPTIONAL: extra Slurm parameters (advanced), added to every job of the pipeline.

gpuMonitorEnable.name: drona_gpu_monitor
gpuMonitorEnable.label: Monitor GPU
gpuMonitorEnable.help: Collect GPU utilization and memory use of the GPU job in the background while it runs, viewable as a live chart under Manage.
